paragraphs.text: Shaper Kopala , Warden of Waves , is a introspective wizard of the River Heralds on Ixalan . He is the youngest of the Nine Shapers.

The nine tributaries of the Great River are prized territories, and merfolk bands are in constant competition for their control. Kopala, a merfolk Shaper with high aspirations, controls the headwaters of the ninth. His desire for status drives him to better his band’s territory.

Kopala survived the New Phyrexian Invasion and the death of the Deeproot Tree . After the discovery of Matzalantli , he was summoned by Shaper Tishana to a tribal congress so that they can decide together the fate of the plane.
